rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for hair, string, wires, or other things that have no knots or tangles.

example.english: After combing my hair, my hair is still untangled.
example.traditional: 梳完頭之後，我啲頭髮仲係冇打結。
example.jyutping: so1 jyun4 tau4 zi1 hau6 ngo5 di1 tau4 faat3 zung6 hai6 mou5 daa2 git3

rows.note: Use this when separate things are not wrapped around or entangled with each other, rather than simply saying there are no knots.

example.english: These two wires are untangled, so you can just place them separately.
example.traditional: 呢兩條電線冇纏住，分開擺就得。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 tiu4 din6 sin3 mou5 cin4 zyu6 fan1 hoi1 baai2 zau6 dak1
